operations.name: AddReview
operations.body: mutation AddReview($clubId: ID!, $bookId: ID!, $rating: Int!, $body: String!) { addReview(clubId: $clubId, bookId: $bookId, rating: $rating, body: $body) { id author { name } } }

operations.name: Book
operations.body: query Book($id: ID!) { book(id: $id) { title reviews(first: 10) { rating body author { name } club { name } } recommendations { id title } } }

operations.name: Catalogue
operations.body: query Catalogue($first: Int = 50) { books(first: $first) { id title } }

operations.name: Club
operations.body: query Club($id: ID!) { club(id: $id) { name private owner { name } members(first: 20) { id name } reviews(first: 20) { id rating body author { name } book { id title } } } }

operations.name: Home
operations.body: query Home { clubs(first: 10) { id name members(first: 10) { name } reviews(first: 5) { rating book { title } } } }

operations.name: JoinClub
operations.body: mutation JoinClub($id: ID!, $code: String!) { joinClub(id: $id, inviteCode: $code) { id name } }

operations.name: Me
operations.body: query Me { viewer { name email clubs(first: 10) { name reviews(first: 5) { body book { title } } } } }

operations.name: Readers
operations.body: query Readers { readers(first: 40) { id name roles } }
